  outputs:
    existing: loadExisting

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadExistingOwner

content.text:
Here is the complete, in-order trace of `POST /api/owners` as the code currently stands (`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` plus its function classes). I've marked each step as **[validation]** (can reject the request) or **[side-effect]** (mutates state / produces output). Transaction governance runs from `checkCityCapacity` through `respond`, so all the writes commit as a single boundary at the end.

## Gate (whole endpoint)
- **[validation] Authorization** — `composition.authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. Caller lacking the role is rejected before any step runs.

## Entry
1. **[validation/branch] `checkIdempotency`** (`CheckOwnerIdempotency`) — reads the optional `Idempotency-Key` header *before* the body is read. If the key was already seen, it short-circuits to `loadExisting` → `respondExisting` (returns the original owner, **200**, no new owner created). Otherwise it takes the `create` branch below.

## Validation / normalization phase (create branch)
2. **[validation] `validate`** (`ValidateOwner`) — binds `@RequestBody @Valid OwnerFieldsDto` (the only body read in the pipeline), triggering the DTO bean-validation constraints (**400** on failure):
   - `firstName` — `@NotNull`, pattern `^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$`, size 1–30
   - `lastName` — `@NotNull`, pattern (allows trailing `.`), size 1–30
   - `title` — pattern `MR|MRS|MS|DR`
   - `address`, `addressLine1`, `addressLine2` — size 1–255
   - `city` — `@NotNull`, size 1–80
   - `postcode` — pattern `^[0-9]{4}$`
   - `telephone` — `@NotNull`, size 1–20
   - `email` — size ≤255, `@Email`
   - `birthDate`, `registrationDate` — `@Valid`
   
   Then a custom check: an address must be present in **either** structured (`addressLine1`) or flat (`address`) form, else `InvalidAddressException` (**400**). Publishes the validated DTO for later steps.
3. **[validation] `validateRegistrationDate`** (`ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate`) — if a `registrationDate` is supplied and is after today, reject with `FutureRegistrationDateException` (**400**). Absent date is allowed.
4. **[side-effect] `normalizeEmail`** (`NormalizeOwnerEmail`) — lower-cases the email in place (null left untouched).
5. **[validation] `validateEmailDomain`** (`ValidateOwnerEmailDomain`) — rejects disposable email domains (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) with `DisposableEmailDomainException` (**400**). Absent/domainless email skipped.
6. **[side-effect + validation] `normalizeAddress`** (`NormalizeOwnerAddress`) — trims, collapses internal whitespace, upper-cases, and expands street abbreviations (`ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`). Structured form preferred and used to compose the flat `address`. An address blank after normalization → `InvalidAddressException` (**400**).
7. **[side-effect + validation] `normalize`** (`NormalizeOwnerTelephone`) — converts telephone to E.164 (strip spaces/dashes/brackets; assume `+61` and drop a leading `0` when no `+`). Must be 8–15 digits, with national-number length matching the country code (`+61`→9, `+1`→10); otherwise `InvalidTelephoneException` (**400**).
8. **[validation] `validatePostcode`** (`ValidateOwnerPostcode`) — if postcode present, range-checks it against the city's region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099); unknown region accepts any 4-digit value. Out of range → `InvalidPostcodeException` (**400**). Absent postcode skipped.

## Capacity gates (transactional)
9. **[validation] `checkCityCapacity`** (`CheckOwnerCityCapacity`) — counts existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive); at ≥50 rejects with `CityOwnerLimitExceededException` (**409**).
10. **[validation] `checkDailyLimit`** (`CheckOwnerDailyLimit`) — counts owners registered on the new owner's effective business day; at ≥100 rejects with `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException` (**429**).

## Build & enrich (transactional)
11. **[side-effect] `build`** (`BuildOwner`) — maps the DTO to an `Owner` entity and sets `registrationDate` to the effective **business-day-adjusted** date (weekends/listed public holidays roll forward to the next business day).
12. **[side-effect] `assignCustomerCode`** (`AssignOwnerCustomerCode`) — sets `customerCode` = `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode, or `UNKNOWN`; HASH8 = first 8 hex of SHA-256 of `telephone + lastName`), appending `-<n>` to resolve collisions with existing codes.
13. **[side-effect] `assignMembershipNumber`** (`AssignOwnerMembershipNumber`) — sets `membershipNumber` = `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, YY being the fiscal year (from 1 July) of the registration date.
14. **[side-effect] `assignHousehold`** (`AssignOwnerHousehold`) — sets deterministic `householdId` = first 12 hex of SHA-256 of `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`.
15. **[validation] `checkHouseholdUnique`** (`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique`) — unless the request's `sharesHousehold` flag is true, rejects with `DuplicateHouseholdException` (**409**) if any existing **non-deleted** owner shares the computed `householdId`.
16. **[side-effect] `deriveHouseholdSize`** (`DeriveOwnerHouseholdSize`) — sets transient `householdSize` = count of owners sharing the `householdId`, including this one.
17. **[side-effect] `countNamesakes`** (`CountOwnerNamesakes`) — sets `namesakeCount` = number of existing non-deleted owners with the same first + last name (case-insensitive).
18. **[side-effect] `detectPossibleDuplicate`** (`DetectOwnerPossibleDuplicate`) — unless `sharesHousehold`, sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` from the earliest existing owner sharing the household (in practice false, since step 15 already blocks the hard case).

## Persist & respond (transactional)
19. **[side-effect] `save`** (`SaveOwner`) — persists the owner (assigns its id).

## Gate (whole endpoint)
- **[validation] Authorization** — `composition.authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. Caller lacking the role is rejected before any step runs.

## Entry
1. **[validation/branch] `checkIdempotency`** (`CheckOwnerIdempotency`) — reads the optional `Idempotency-Key` header *before* the body is read. If the key was already seen, it short-circuits to `loadExisting` → `respondExisting` (returns the original owner, **200**, no new owner created). Otherwise it takes the `create` branch below.

## Validation / normalization phase (create branch)
2. **[validation] `validate`** (`ValidateOwner`) — binds `@RequestBody @Valid OwnerFieldsDto` (the only body read in the pipeline), triggering the DTO bean-validation constraints (**400** on failure):
   - `firstName` — `@NotNull`, pattern `^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$`, size 1–30
   - `lastName` — `@NotNull`, pattern (allows trailing `.`), size 1–30
   - `title` — pattern `MR|MRS|MS|DR`
   - `address`, `addressLine1`, `addressLine2` — size 1–255
   - `city` — `@NotNull`, size 1–80
   - `postcode` — pattern `^[0-9]{4}$`
   - `telephone` — `@NotNull`, size 1–20
   - `email` — size ≤255, `@Email`
   - `birthDate`, `registrationDate` — `@Valid`
   
   Then a custom check: an address must be present in **either** structured (`addressLine1`) or flat (`address`) form, else `InvalidAddressException` (**400**). Publishes the validated DTO for later steps.
3. **[validation] `validateRegistrationDate`** (`ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate`) — if a `registrationDate` is supplied and is after today, reject with `FutureRegistrationDateException` (**400**). Absent date is allowed.
4. **[side-effect] `normalizeEmail`** (`NormalizeOwnerEmail`) — lower-cases the email in place (null left untouched).
5. **[validation] `validateEmailDomain`** (`ValidateOwnerEmailDomain`) — rejects disposable email domains (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) with `DisposableEmailDomainException` (**400**). Absent/domainless email skipped.
6. **[side-effect + validation] `normalizeAddress`** (`NormalizeOwnerAddress`) — trims, collapses internal whitespace, upper-cases, and expands street abbreviations (`ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`). Structured form preferred and used to compose the flat `address`. An address blank after normalization → `InvalidAddressException` (**400**).
7. **[side-effect + validation] `normalize`** (`NormalizeOwnerTelephone`) — converts telephone to E.164 (strip spaces/dashes/brackets; assume `+61` and drop a leading `0` when no `+`). 8. **[validation] `validatePostcode`** (`ValidateOwnerPostcode`) — if postcode present, range-checks it against the city's region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099); unknown region accepts any 4-digit value. Out of range → `InvalidPostcodeException` (**400**). Absent postcode skipped.

## Capacity gates (transactional)
9. **[validation] `checkCityCapacity`** (`CheckOwnerCityCapacity`) — counts existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive); at ≥50 rejects with `CityOwnerLimitExceededException` (**409**).
10. **[validation] `checkDailyLimit`** (`CheckOwnerDailyLimit`) — counts owners registered on the new owner's effective business day; at ≥100 rejects with `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException` (**429**).
